verdicts.reason: Both are the same weak 320x50 crop. The robot vacuum is cropped to an unrecognisable dark rim. The purple brand circle is cut down to a tiny wedge in the bottom-left corner, and the outline frame and dot pattern are gone. The 'Smart Home / GADGETS' text now sits directly on the wood photo with no purple panel behind it, and it is small. A at least leaves some breathing room on the right. In B the text is pushed hard against the right canvas edge, which looks cramped and accidental.
